_readme: Ratchet for scripts/ci/assert-rls-floor.mjs (rls-floor-guard). Entries may only be removed: an entry that is compliant again fails the job until it is deleted. tables = check a (RLS or FORCE off); policies = check c findings with a tracked fix; referenceData = reviewed public catalogs whose SELECT policy is USING (true) on purpose.
